subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust `openai/codex-action@52fe01ec70a42f454c9d2ebd47598f9fd6893d56` in the three updated Codex-agent workflows, including the API-key-bearing performance-agent job?
rationale: This is a credential-bound third-party action trust decision; a dependency bump cannot establish that acceptance without direct exact-revision source review and maintainer intent.

options.title: Audit then merge
options.body: Inspect the exact pinned action source and secret-handling behavior, document approval, and merge after current-head checks pass.

options.title: Keep existing pin
options.body: Decline this Codex action update while retaining the other action revisions only in a narrowed replacement PR.

options.title: Pause the group bump
options.body: Close or pause this grouped update until the repository has an approved process for this credential-bearing action revision.

recommendation.title: Audit then merge
recommendation.body: Inspect the exact pinned action source and secret-handling behavior, document approval, and merge after current-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline provides a weak but concrete workflow-review routing signal; final ownership needs confirmation from repository history or an explicit maintainer response.
